nodes.summary: The generalized Pauplin coefficient of the pair of clusters `u, v` in the tree `T_ab` obtained from the star on `S` by joining `a` and `b`: `1/2` for `{a, b}`; `1/(2(|S| - 2))` when one of `u, v` is `a` or `b` and the other is not; `1/(|S| - 2)` when neither is. Values on the diagonal `u = v` are never used.
nodes.title: Generalized Pauplin coefficient of a cherry tree

nodes.summary: Let `T_ab` carry real edge lengths: `ℓ c` on the pendant edge of each cluster `c ∈ S` and `m` on the edge between `u` and the center. If `D` is its path-length dissimilarity (`D a b = ℓ a + ℓ b`, `D x c = ℓ x + m + ℓ c` for `x ∈ {a, b}` and `c` another cluster, `D c c' = ℓ c + ℓ c'` for two other distinct clusters), then `cherryLength S D a b = ∑_{c ∈ S} ℓ c + m`.
nodes.title: The coefficients give the tree length

nodes.summary: For `D` symmetric and zero on the diagonal of `S`, `|S| ≥ 3` and distinct `a, b ∈ S`: `cherryLength S D a b = (∑_{u ≠ v ∈ S} D u v + Q(a, b)) / (2 (|S| - 2))`.
nodes.title: The BME length of a join in terms of the Q-criterion

nodes.summary: The balanced minimum-evolution length of `T_ab` for the dissimilarity `D`: half the sum over ordered pairs of distinct clusters of `cherryCoeff S a b u v * D u v`, which is `∑_{u<v} cherryCoeff S a b u v * D u v` when `D` is symmetric.
nodes.title: Balanced minimum-evolution length of a cherry tree

nodes.summary: At every state of a run on a symmetric dissimilarity with zero diagonal and at least three clusters, a pair of distinct clusters minimizes the Q-criterion (the pairs NJ may join) if and only if joining it gives the smallest `cherryLength`, the BME length of the join tree `T_ab` on the current clusters for the current cluster dissimilarity `D`. This is the local star identity only: it does not compare partially…
nodes.title: Q-minimality is cherry-length minimality at a run state

nodes.summary: The BME length of `T_ab` on the current clusters for the current cluster dissimilarity `D`. This is the local star identity; it is not the full Gascuel–Steel comparison on all taxa.
nodes.title: Minimizing `Q` is minimizing the local star BME length of the join

nodes.summary: Along a run of neighbor joining on a symmetric `d` with zero diagonal, the cluster dissimilarity stays symmetric and vanishes on every current cluster.
nodes.title: Neighbor joining preserves symmetry and zero diagonal
